{{Top|leg}}
A '''jet-stream meditation pool''' was a luxury recreational feature. [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] outfitted the ''[[Lady Luck/Legends|Lady Luck]]''{{'s}} interior compartment with a small jet-stream meditation pool and several [[conform-couch]]es.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> The ''[[Asaari Wind]]'', a modified [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] owned by the Bimm [[Crime lord/Legends|crimelord]] [[Ritinki]], was furnished with a jet-stream meditation pool located in a lounge on the ship's upper deck.<ref name="HerdHeist">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
